headline: Transfer rumors, news: Alexander-Arnold to return to Liverpool?
description: A potential move back to Liverpool for Real Madrid defender Trent Alexander-Arnold could be in the cards. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Virgil van Dijk: Liverpool must 'take that risk' under Andoni Iraola playing style
description: Andoni Iraola's brand of risk-reward football is starting to take hold at Liverpool and captain Virgil van Dijk has said the players are becoming increasingly confident at committing to the game plan.

headline: Are Man City fans right about a Premier League 'Red Cartel' that's out to get them?
description: Man City fans have insisted for years that the likes of Liverpool, Man United and Arsenal have been conspiring against them, which is why City have been punished. Is it an attempt to deflect blame, or a justified feeling?

headline: Enzo Maresca: Gianluigi Donnarumma not 'undroppable' but will be first name on team sheet
description: Enzo Maresca insists Gianluigi Donnarumma is not undroppable -- but he will be the first name on the Manchester City team sheet this weekend.

headline: Junior Kroupi not yet ready to start, according to Bournemouth boss Marco Rose
description: Marco Rose will hold Bournemouth forward Junior Kroupi back for a little longer despite more minutes in midweek.

headline: Chelsea boss Xabi Alonso: 'No discussion' over Estêvão loan move
description: Xabi Alonso has said there have been "no discussions" about sending Estêvão on loan despite the Brazil star's limited minutes this term.
